headline: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei slams rivals over 'human control' AI slogans
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei criticised rival AI leaders on X for marketing 'human control' slogans without addressing autonomous system risks. Responding to an Axios report, Amodei rejected handing governance to AI while warning of job displacement, autonomous self-improvement, and unreliable automated safety research across broadly similar rival models.
why_it_matters: Public friction among frontier labs exposes how commercial positioning on human agency often masks unresolved technical disagreements over governing increasingly autonomous AI.

headline: India draws $31 billion in climate equity, mostly for power and transport
summary: India attracted $31 billion in climate and sustainability equity funding between 2021 and October 2026, an IVCA and BCG report showed Thursday. Power and low-carbon fuels captured $19 billion and transport $9.5 billion, while agriculture, waste, and manufacturing drew just $1 billion each against $500 billion needed annually.
why_it_matters: Heavy industry and climate adaptation remain severely underfunded because long project timelines outlast typical investment fund lives, demanding clearer green taxonomies and blended finance.
source_search: India draws $31 billion in climate equity, mostly for power and transport Hindu BusinessLine

headline: Bengaluru deeptech startup Green Aero raises $14 million for drone jet engines
summary: Bengaluru-based Green Aero has raised $14 million in a Series A round led by Crane Ventures to build indigenous jet engines and autonomous combat aircraft. Founded in 2023 by Prithwish Kundu, the startup has completed over 100 ground-fire tests and is moving toward flight testing its transonic drone platforms.
why_it_matters: Private capital backing indigenous propulsion and collaborative combat aircraft strengthens India's domestic defence manufacturing base as modern warfare shifts toward fast autonomous drones.

headline: Fitch expects Indian banks to sustain 15% loan growth through FY28
summary: Fitch Ratings forecast on Thursday that Indian banks will sustain roughly 15% annual loan growth through March 2028, supported by solid economic expansion. Although credit costs may edge up to 0.8% from 0.6% in FY27 on unsecured personal and farm loans, bad-loan ratios should stay below 2%.
why_it_matters: Resilient credit demand alongside rising cost efficiency and modest rate support allows Indian lenders to absorb mild retail asset-quality stress without eroding capital.
source_search: Fitch expects Indian banks to sustain 15% loan growth through FY28 Hindu BusinessLine

headline: WhatsApp rolls out global message scheduling up to 14 days ahead
summary: Meta-owned WhatsApp has launched scheduled messaging globally, letting users queue texts, photos, and videos between ten minutes and 14 days ahead across individual and group chats. Announced by global head Kunal Shah, queued messages deliver even when senders' phones are off, without indicating they were scheduled.
why_it_matters: Adding long-requested scheduling supports WhatsApp's broader push under Shah to turn its 500-million-user Indian base into an everyday utility and payments hub.
source_search: WhatsApp rolls out global message scheduling up to 14 days ahead Inc42

headline: AI stock volatility and political shocks rattle Wall Street's carry trade
summary: The Bloomberg FX Carry Index faces its first monthly loss of 2026 in November, falling 0.9% despite remaining up 6.8% this year. Cracks in AI equities and Brazil's election shock have disrupted calm markets, prompting Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and Wells Fargo to caution against indiscriminate emerging-market currency bets.
why_it_matters: Higher currency volatility threatens leveraged global trades that borrow cheap dollars, yen, or euros, potentially tightening capital flows into emerging markets heading into 2027.
source_search: AI stock volatility and political shocks rattle Wall Street's carry trade Hindu BusinessLine

headline: Oliver Bearman commits to Haas for 2027 after protracted Ferrari talks
summary: Haas announced on Thursday at the Qatar Grand Prix that British driver Oliver Bearman, 21, will race for the team in 2027. The deal secures Bearman's third full Formula 1 season alongside fellow Ferrari academy driver Rafael Camara, ending protracted negotiations over his future career options.
why_it_matters: With Charles Leclerc on a long-term Ferrari contract and Lewis Hamilton keen to extend beyond 2027, Haas gives Bearman guaranteed grid continuity.
source_search: Oliver Bearman commits to Haas for 2027 after protracted Ferrari talks BBC Sport

headline: JioStar brings seven Indian television channels to Fubo in the U.S.
summary: India's JioStar has launched seven linear channels, including Star Plus, Colors, MTV India and News18 English, on American live TV service Fubo. Viewers can subscribe through a $10.99 monthly pack or a cricket bundle, extending JioStar's overseas footprint beyond its September JioHotstar launches in Canada, Singapore and the U.K.
why_it_matters: Packaging Hindi dramas, Bollywood cinema, youth formats and news on a major U.S. service helps JioStar capture diaspora viewers and broaden Indian television's international reach.
source_search: JioStar brings seven Indian television channels to Fubo in the U.S. Variety

headline: Over 38,000 adults wait for autism and ADHD assessments in Scotland
summary: More than 38,000 adults in Scotland are awaiting neurodevelopmental assessments, with at least 14,000 waiting over two years, figures seen by BBC Scotland show. Clydebank GP Dr Marianne McCallum warned that overwhelmed secondary services and rising private ADHD and autism referrals leave vulnerable patients unable to get help.
why_it_matters: Most GPs will not prescribe NHS-funded ADHD medication for private diagnoses, forcing struggling patients to pay privately or risk losing jobs while awaiting care.
source_search: Over 38,000 adults wait for autism and ADHD assessments in Scotland BBC

headline: Digital lender Finnable raises ₹405 crore Series C from Bharat Value Fund
summary: Bengaluru-based digital lending startup Finnable raised ₹405 crore in a Series C round led by Bharat Value Fund, which invested ₹150 crore. Serving mid-income salaried borrowers with assets under management exceeding ₹4,600 crore, Finnable posted ₹51 crore in first-half FY27 profit after tax, beating all of FY26.
why_it_matters: Fresh capital and rising profits show sustained investor appetite for profitable retail fintech lenders serving salaried Indians underserved by traditional banks.
source_search: Digital lender Finnable raises ₹405 crore Series C from Bharat Value Fund Inc42

headline: Indian Youth Congress moves Delhi High Court over Meta automated takedowns
summary: Indian Youth Congress secretary Manu Jain petitioned the Delhi High Court against IT Rules 2021 Rule 4(4), which mandates automated blocking of previously restricted content. Jain alleged Meta used Rahul Gandhi's name and photographs as keywords to block ordinary posts on Instagram and Facebook without citing specific blocking orders.
why_it_matters: Testing automated takedown mandates in court could force social platforms and regulators to disclose opaque blocking criteria and tighten safeguards for political speech online.
source_search: Indian Youth Congress moves Delhi High Court over Meta automated takedowns Inc42

headline: Uber taps former Zomato food delivery chief to lead India operations
summary: Uber appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as President for India and South Asia on Thursday, effective January 4, 2027. Currently CEO at Allen Online, Ranjan will oversee Uber's third-largest global market by trips, spanning over 200 Indian cities and two million monthly active drivers.
why_it_matters: Bringing in a seasoned Indian consumer-tech operator signals Uber's focus on improving driver earnings and ride reliability across its second-largest global earner base.
source_search: Uber taps former Zomato food delivery chief to lead India operations Hindu BusinessLine

headline: Min Woo Lee shoots opening 68 at Australian PGA minus eight-iron
summary: Australian golfer Min Woo Lee shot a four-under 68 in the first round of the Australian PGA Championship despite playing without his eight-iron. Lee lost track of the club while tutoring Formula 1 drivers Carlos Sainz and Lance Stroll in Las Vegas, finishing four shots behind leader Haydn Barron.
why_it_matters: With his missing club now recovered in Sydney, Lee remains well inside early contention on the DP World Tour despite improvising approach shots all round.
source_search: Min Woo Lee shoots opening 68 at Australian PGA minus eight-iron BBC Sport

headline: Ivory Coast deploys loan guarantees and tax breaks for African cinema
summary: Ivory Coast is rolling out a state-backed financing guarantee scheme at Abidjan's SICA audiovisual market, pooling up to three billion CFA francs with NSIA Banque to unlock $10 million in producer loans. Its newly adopted 2027 finance bill also introduces tax incentives for filming equipment and cinema construction.
why_it_matters: With talks underway with Afreximbank to scale the 2027 pilot continent-wide, Ivory Coast aims to tackle Africa's biggest filmmaking bottleneck: scarce upfront production capital.
source_search: Ivory Coast deploys loan guarantees and tax breaks for African cinema Variety

headline: Chinese cities sweep chemistry top ten in 2025 Nature Index rankings
summary: Beijing held first place overall in the Nature Index 2025 city rankings, while five more Chinese cities joined the top ten since 2016. Chinese cities swept all ten chemistry spots and claimed four biological sciences places, while two former US top-ten hubs fell outside the top twenty.
why_it_matters: China's rapid gains in adjusted research share signal a sustained geographic shift in high-impact scientific output, eroding decades of Western metropolitan dominance.
source_search: Chinese cities sweep chemistry top ten in 2025 Nature Index rankings Nature

headline: NHS Grampian surgeon removed before operating under influence of drugs
summary: A senior manager removed an NHS Grampian surgeon from an Elgin operating theatre after he arrived under drugs following an endoscopy to finish a knee operation. NHS Grampian says both that case and an alleged theatre altercation over a threatened wrong-hip surgery were handled through governance processes.
why_it_matters: The whistleblower disclosures deepen scrutiny on NHS Grampian's leadership less than two weeks after Healthcare Improvement Scotland exposed serious governance shortcomings across the health board.
source_search: NHS Grampian surgeon removed before operating under influence of drugs BBC
